Intertextuality is a method, skill, or discipline and a guide for the scientific analysis of texts, especially artistic and non-artistic works, to determine the presence of influence through borrowing or dialogue; that is, the similarity in form, content, and technique between one text and another. This resemblance can be direct or involve proximity. Such interaction is also referred to as an echo. It is believed that intertextuality is among the oldest compositional techniques; however, as a critical approach, it still appears to be unfamiliar and has not been extensively addressed in the field of Kiswahili literature and art. For this reason, this article will contribute to the Kiswahili body of work dealing with criticism through the theory of intertextuality, in order to identify the intertextuality present in texts, for example in the play Our Cohesion Our Triumph. The results of the analysis have revealed a considerable presence of intertextuality connected to the author’s upbringing and development in religious (spiritual), physical (cultural and moral), social, and academic dimensions – in one way or another. It is part of these findings that constitutes this article. Therefore, this article presents the intertextuality between the selected play Our Cohesion Our Triumph and writings from sacred books, allegory in the selection and creation of characters, philosophical echoes, chapter or plot titles, and the mythology of symbols. The play employs language that is quickly and easily understood by anyone well-versed in Kiswahili. The dialogues constructed in this play evoke a variety of themes such as liberation, the role of women in society, social classes, sabotage, selfishness, intrigue, oppression, hatred, jealousy, greed, betrayal, exploitation, abuse, discrimination, transparency and truth, customs and traditions, unity and solidarity, family upbringing, effort and sustainable development, the importance of preserving records and identifying property, as well as the management and advancement of property, among others. What is important for the reader of this article to understand is that intertextuality cannot be identified in a text if the analyst lacks background knowledge or familiarity with the knowledge, techniques, skills, and traits found in various preceding texts. Therefore, a person who can identify intertextuality in artistic works must be a highly knowledgeable and inquisitive individual, someone with a thirst and hunger for knowledge, techniques, skills, and the characteristic curiosity gained through exploring various creative works and a range of academic writings. On the contrary, a reader will not be able to discern the intertextuality within the creative work they are reading if they do not mentally perceive the resonances of knowledge, techniques, skills, and traits found in earlier works. The play is rich in various artistic and theoretical experiments and techniques. For example, within the play, there is intertextuality as each chapter is given a subtopic that refers to linguistic terms from the field of structural linguistics, in order to illustrate the birth and development of the subject matter being discussed by the author. In this book, these scholars explain that, typically, the human brain has an area responsible for recording, storing, and rapidly retrieving memories of events and experiences a person has encountered. Therefore, when a reader comes across an event or technique that they have previously encountered in another work, their mind immediately responds and triggers a sensation that draws on the recall of that event or technique. The retrieval of a previous event, matter, or technique in relation to what has just been encountered produces an intersection of two texts. This intersection creates a resonance of the event, technique, or matter within the reader’s mind. All of these processes occur very rapidly. Therefore, you cannot recognize the presence of intertextuality if you are not a keen reader or a careful follower of different matters and various writings—both extensively and in depth. Allegory is an artistic device used by a writer to choose a name that reflects the character, behavior, and experiences of a character in the work they are creating. For example, a writer may name their character “Hasidi” (The Envious One). To justify this name, the writer must develop that character to act with envy from beginning to end. The selection and creation of characters whose traits align with their names is the artistic technique known as allegory. Normally, these characters possess the traits of flat characters (those who do not undergo changes in character) in order to justify their names, because if they were to change in character, their names would no longer correspond to their new traits. Therefore, in terms of character and stance, these characters remain unchanged from the beginning to the end of the play. Mlacha and Madumulla (1991) describe such characters as ones who do not appear to grow in character, actions, or psychologically. The main goal of this approach is to persuade the public to embrace good deeds and names that embody goodness, so as to reject evil and oppose the use of names that carry negative meanings, since African societies believe that a name shapes the character of the individual. An echo is a sound that is repeated after being produced, such as when a person shouts inside a cave or forest, while philosophy refers to the study of the nature, meaning, and reasons for things, as well as wisdom and prudence (Kamusi ya Kiswahili Sanifu, 2013). Therefore, a philosophical echo is a sound that is repeated after being produced through the study of the nature, meaning, and reasons for things, as well as wisdom and prudence. The play "Our Unity, Our Triumph" portrays a woman enduring intense and painful struggles for liberation. The play shows how the woman finds herself on the verge of despair, almost accepting defeat, but with the support of a large community that joins her, she ultimately emerges victorious. This is a philosophical echo that reminds us of the saying that one finger cannot kill a louse and that unity is always victory. According to the Standard Swahili Dictionary (TUKI, 2013), the word “word” is defined as a group of sounds that are spoken or written together to convey meaning. And so, when words are grouped into different units that have not yet reached the status of a clause or a sentence, they are called phrases (Kipacha, 2005). Therefore, a word and another word form a phrase. Likewise, when phrases are brought together, they form clauses. Massamba (2004) defines a clause as "a construction with a subject and a predicate that exists within a main construction." Several clauses combine to form a sentence; and when several sentences are brought together, they form a construction, which then forms a paragraph, and paragraphs in turn produce an essay. A sentence is a self-contained construction that essentially involves an action and an agent (TUKI, 2013). Hata hivyo, makala hii inawasilisha vipengele vitano mahsusi tu ambavyo vimepewa msisitizo katika tamthilia iliyochaguliwa. Hivi ni pamoja na maandishi ya kidini (maandishi kutoka kwenye vitabu vitakatifu), tamathali katika uteuzi na uundaji wa wahusika, sauti za kifalsafa, mada ya sura au njama, na mytholojia ya alama. MFUMO WA KINADHARIA  
Kanuni hizi ni: (i) si rahisi na kwa hakika haiwezekani kuangalia maandishi kama zao ambalo ni yatima, katika upekee wake na bila uhusiano na mengine; badala yake, ni lazima kutambua kwamba kuna maandishi yaliyotangulia ambayo yamehusishwa na maandishi mapya; (ii) maandishi huingiliana na kuathiriana, hivyo kufikiri kwamba andiko la kifasihi linajitosheleza na ni huru ni kupuuza kwa makusudi; na (iii) andiko la kisanii huvutia mbinu fulani za uwasilishaji na misimbo maalumu ambayo husaidia kuashiria wazo, tukio, kazi, au kazi nyingine inayofuata—hivyo basi kuleta athari katika kazi ya ubunifu inayofuata (Kristeva, 1980). Kulingana na kanuni hizi, tunaweza kusema kuwa mwingiliano ni nadharia na ujuzi wa kitaaluma ambao unachunguza, kubainisha, na kufafanua mahusiano yaliyopo kati ya andiko moja na jingine, ili kubaini athari za moja kwa moja au zisizo za moja kwa moja (sauti zilizorudiwa) zinazosababishwa na mwingiliano na kuimarishana kwa maandishi haya. Kwa maneno mengine, nadharia ya mwingiliano ni mwongozo wa kuchambua kazi za sanaa, hasa kazi za kifasihi, ili kubaini kuwepo kwa kukopa au mazungumzo; yaani, kufanana kwa aina, dhamira, na mbinu kati ya andiko moja na jingine. Uchambuzi uliongozwa na nadharia ya Mwingiliano. Nadharia hii ilitokana na mawazo ya mdahalo wa msomi wa Kirusi, Mikhail Bakhtin (alizaliwa 1895, alifariki 1975), na baadaye ikaboresha na mwanaisimu wa Kifaransa, Julia Kristeva (Wamitila, 2002; Wafula na Njogu, 2007). Hapa ni sahihi kusema kwamba Julia Kristeva ndiye mwanzilishi wa nadharia ya mwingiliano baada ya kuboresha nadharia ya Dialogism ya Mikhail Bakhtin katika miaka ya 1960. Bakhtin anatushawishi kwamba kazi yoyote ya fasihi ina mkusanyiko wa sauti mbalimbali. Mwingiliano huu wa maandishi, kwa maneno mengine, pia huitwa mwangwi. walio pembezoni; hasa wanawake na watoto. Tamthilia hii inatathmini athari hizi na kisha inapendekeza jinsi ukombozi wa kielimu, kitamaduni, na kijamii unavyopaswa kukuza umoja na ushirikiano ndani ya jamii pana ili kuwasaidia waliopembezoni kujikomboa wenyewe. Tamthilia hii inatumia lugha ambayo inaeleweka kwa haraka na urahisi na mtu yeyote aliyebobea katika Kiswahili. Mazungumzo yaliyoundwa katika tamthilia hii yanachochea mada mbalimbali kama vile ukombozi, nafasi ya wanawake katika jamii, tabaka za kijamii, hujuma, ubinafsi, fitina, ukandamizaji, chuki, wivu, tamaa, usaliti, unyonyaji, unyanyasaji, ubaguzi, uwazi na ukweli, desturi na mila, umoja na mshikamano, malezi ya familia, juhudi na maendeleo endelevu, umuhimu wa kuhifadhi kumbukumbu na utambuzi wa mali, pamoja na usimamizi na uendelezaji wa mali, na mengineyo. Jambo muhimu kwa msomaji wa makala hii kuelewa ni kwamba mwingiliano hauwezi kubainishwa katika maandishi endapo mchambuzi hana maarifa ya awali au ufahamu wa maarifa, mbinu, ujuzi, na sifa zilizopo katika maandishi mbalimbali yaliyotangulia. Hivyo basi, mtu anayeweza kubaini mwingiliano katika kazi za kisanii ni yule aliye na maarifa ya kina na mwenye hamu na shauku ya kujifunza; mtu mwenye kiu na njaa ya maarifa, mbinu, ujuzi, na udadisi unaopatikana kupitia kuchunguza kazi mbalimbali za ubunifu na maandishi ya kitaaluma tofauti tofauti. Kinyume chake, msomaji hataweza kutambua mwingiliano uliomo katika kazi ya ubunifu anayoisoma endapo hataweza kung’amua kiakili mwangwi wa maarifa, mbinu, ujuzi, na sifa zilizopo katika kazi zilizotangulia. Tamthilia hii imejaa majaribio na mbinu mbalimbali za kisanaa na kinadharia. Kwa mfano, ndani ya tamthilia kunapatikana mwingiliano ambapo kila sura inapewa kichwa kidogo kinachorejelea istilahi za kiisimu kutoka katika taaluma ya isimu muundo, ili kuonesha kuzaliwa na kukua kwa mada inayojadiliwa na mwandishi. Aina nyingine ya mwingiliano inapatikana katika matumizi ya michoro na picha, mbinu za uandishi wa hadithi, na upanuzi usio wa kawaida wa maelekezo ya jukwaani, pamoja na ujumuishaji wa ngoma, nyimbo, muziki, mashairi, majigambo, utenzi wa kwaya, na uwasilishaji wa Joka (Mgimba, 2017). Aidha, hata uchaguzi wa jina “Sumukuvu,” ambalo linaakisi tabia na matendo yanayoashiria sifa za kitu au kiumbe fulani, unaonyesha upande mwingine wa kazi hii: kuwepo kwa sifa za kawaida za wahusika katika fasihi simulizi. Kwa mfano, mhusika Sumukuvu anaweza kuonekana aidha kama mhusika wa kibinadamu mwenye jina linalofanana na sumu, au kama mhusika wa fasihi simulizi ambaye ametwaliwa na kupewa uhai, kisha akatekeleza majukumu kama binadamu. Sababu hii inalingana na kile kilichoelezwa kwa undani na Taylor na Taylor (1983) katika kitabu chao mashuhuri *The Psychology of Reading*. Katika kitabu hiki, wataalamu hawa wanaeleza kwamba, kawaida, ubongo wa binadamu una sehemu maalumu inayohusika na kurekodi, kuhifadhi na kurejesha kwa haraka kumbukumbu za matukio na uzoefu ambayo mtu amewahi kukutana nayo. Hivyo, msomaji anapokutana na tukio au mbinu ambayo ameishawahi kukutana nayo katika kazi nyingine, akili yake hujibu mara moja na kuchochea hisia inayotia mkazo katika kukumbuka tukio au mbinu hiyo. Urejeshaji wa tukio, jambo, au mbinu ya awali kwa kuhusianisha na kile ambacho msomaji amekutana nacho hivi punde huzalisha mkutano kati ya maandishi mawili. Mkutano huu huunda mwangwi wa tukio, mbinu, au jambo hilo ndani ya akili ya msomaji. Mchakato huu wote hutokea kwa haraka sana. Kwa hiyo, huwezi kutambua kuwepo kwa mwingiliano iwapo hauko msomaji makini au mfuatiliaji kwa makini wa masuala mbalimbali na maandishi tofauti—kwa upana na kwa undani. MUHTASARI WA TAMTHILIA MSHIKAMANO WETU USHINDI WETU  
Mshikamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu ni tamthilia ya Kiswahili yenye msimamo mkali wa kimwanamke, inayochambua athari za tabia na vitendo vya baadhi ya wanajamii wanaoendeleza imani potofu, wivu, chuki, ubinafsi, na aina mbalimbali za ukatili dhidi ya wengine.  
Katika sekta ya kilimo, Sumukuvu (sumu kuvu) hurejelea sumu au kemikali hatari zinazozalishwa na aina ya ukungu uitwao Kuvu, ambayo hukua na mara nyingi hushambulia mimea ya chakula na mazao ya mafuta, hasa yale yenye majani na mbegu, kama vile nafaka, kunde, mizizi, karanga na malisho ya wanyama mashambani au wakati wa kuhifadhi. Sumukuvu haiwezi kuonekana kwa macho ya kawaida bali inaweza kugunduliwa kwa kutumia vipimo maalum vya maabara. Aidha, tamthilia hii inatambulisha taswira kadhaa, ikiwemo joka, taa ya kijani, ukungu mzito, giza, na ajali. Aina nyingine ya utajiri inapatikana katika maumbo mbalimbali ya usemi, ikiwa ni pamoja na aina tofauti za tamathali za usemi kama vile vitendawili, nahau, methali, mafumbo, na sitiari. Vivyo hivyo, pamoja na huzuni, mwandishi ameingiza ucheshi kama njia ya kuleta faraja na kurejesha amani iliyokuwa imetoweka katika familia. KUHUSU MWANDISHI ANITHA ELIAS MGIMBA  
na kujiamini kila anapoingia uwanjani kukabiliana na timu pinzani. Aidha, tofauti na masista wengi, Anitha alipitia mafunzo ya Jeshi la Kujenga Taifa (J.K.T) hapa Tanzania, kama inavyotakiwa kisheria, katika Kambi ya 832KJ - J.K.T Ruvu, Mkoa wa Pwani, mwaka 2013. Sababu ya yeye kuhudhuria mafunzo hayo ya kijeshi ni kwamba Mama Mkuu (aliyekuwa amechaguliwa tena kwa muhula mwingine—kwa mara ya tatu), Sr. Teresina Gervasia Kindole, aliwahimiza na kusisitiza kwa kila aliyeteuliwa kujiunga na programu hiyo ahudhurie mafunzo hayo bila kujali wito wao wa kitawa. Uamuzi huu na msimamo thabiti wa Mama Mkuu unatokana na ukweli kwamba yeye mwenyewe alipitia mafunzo ya J.K.T kama inavyotakiwa kisheria, na hivyo hakuliona tatizo lolote kwa masista wake kuhudhuria mafunzo hayo, kutokana na manufaa aliyoyapata yeye binafsi kupitia jeshi. Tamthilia Mshikamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu ni kazi yake ya kwanza kuandika, kuchapisha, na kuiachilia sokoni. Anitha anasema kwamba, katika maisha yake, “anapendelea kusoma vitabu vya dini, sosholojia, lugha, na fasihi—hasa tamthilia—kuliko aina nyingine za fasihi.” Hata uandishi wa tamthilia hii umetumia mbinu mbalimbali na umekopa kutoka katika ulimwengu mpana unaojumuisha maandishi ya kubuni, maandishi ya kisosholojia, mitazamo ya kike na uzoefu halisi wa maisha unaotawala jamii zetu. Kwa hiyo, tunaweza kusema kwamba maisha ya kitawa na maisha ya kawaida ya jamii inayomzunguka Anitha vimejumuika katika muundo wa tamthilia hii, na hivyo kuzaliwa kwa Mshikamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu. Anitha ana ndoto ya kuandika kazi nyingi zaidi za ubunifu na bora. Anitha Elias Mgimba ni mtawa Mkatholiki kutoka Tanzania wa Shirika la Masista Wamisionari wa Mtakatifu. Theresia wa Mtoto Yesu Iringa, Tanzania. Aliijiunga na shirika hilo mwaka 2010 chini ya uongozi wa Mama Mkuu wa wakati huo, Sr. Teresina Gervasia Kindole. Anitha Elias Mgimba alizaliwa tarehe 24. 2. 1994 katika kijiji cha Manga, Wilaya ya Ludewa, Mkoa wa Iringa (kwa wakati huo). Kwa sasa, Wilaya ya Ludewa ni miongoni mwa wilaya zinazounda Mkoa wa Njombe, ambako wazazi wake bado wanaishi hadi leo. Anitha ni mtoto wa kwanza kati ya watoto sita waliozaliwa na wazazi wakulima, Bwana Elias Mgimba na Bi. Elimunda Mbigi. Watoto wengine na kazi zao (kwenye mabano) ni Renhard Mgimba (Dereva), Johns Mgimba (Mwalimu), Rosamunda Mgimba (Muuguzi), Leticia Mgimba (Mwanafunzi, mafunzo ya umeme), na Mario Mgimba (Mwanafunzi, mafunzo ya uandishi wa habari). Alipata elimu yake ya msingi katika Shule ya Msingi Manga (1999 - 2006), huku elimu yake ya sekondari ya chini (2007 – 2010) na sekondari ya juu (2011 – 2013) akiipata katika Shule ya Sekondari Pandahili, katika Mkoa wa Mbeya. MWINGILIANO KATIKA MSHIKAMANO WETU USHINDI WETU  
Uchambuzi uliofanyika kuhusu tamthilia hii umebainisha kuwa kuna mwingiliano mkubwa ndani yake. Hata hivyo, kwa madhumuni ya makala hii, tutajadili mwingiliano unaohusiana na: maandishi kutoka kwenye vitabu vitakatifu, tamathali katika uteuzi na uundaji wa wahusika, sauti za kifalsafa, mada ya sura au njama, na mytholojia ya alama, kama sehemu ya kuzingatia kikomo cha maneno kinachohitajika na jarida hili. Alipata elimu yake ya juu katika Chuo Kikuu cha Kikatoliki cha Mwenge kilichopo Moshi, Kilimanjaro (2014–2017), ambako alisoma na kuhitimu Shahada ya Elimu ya Sanaa, akibobea katika Historia na Kiswahili, bila kusahau somo la Uandishi wa Ubunifu. Kwa sasa anaendelea na masomo ya juu—Shahada ya Uzamili ya Elimu katika Utawala na Mipango katika Chuo Kikuu cha Mtakatifu Augustine, Mwanza, Tanzania. Mbali na masomo yake ya uzamili, Anitha ni mwalimu wa shule ya sekondari, akifundisha Historia na Kiswahili katika shule ya shirika lake iitwayo St. John Paul II Iringa. Chakula anachokipenda zaidi ni ugali na samaki. Anapenda pia kuhudumia jamii kwa kufundisha. Anitha ni mchezaji mahiri wa netiboli anayebobea katika nafasi ya ulinzi langoni (GK), jukumu analolitimiza kwa ustadi mkubwa kiasi kwamba limeongeza umaarufu na sifa yake.

Jedwali hili linaonyesha nukuu tulizobaini kutoka kwenye tamthilia ya "Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu" ambazo zinafanana au zinaendana na nukuu kutoka katika Biblia Takatifu. Huu ni ushahidi usiopingika kwamba tamthilia hii haikuandikwa bila misingi, bali mwandishi alichota maarifa, ujuzi na uzoefu kutoka katika maandiko matakatifu ya dini iliyomlea na kumkuza, kama tulivyobainisha katika wasifu wake. Nukuu zote tulizorejelea zinaakisi wazi athari za maandiko yaliyotangulia, na hivyo kudhihirisha kwa nguvu kwamba uandishi na utunzi haviwezi kutenganishwa na ushawishi wa maandiko yaliyotangulia au mazingira ya kimwili na kiroho yaliyomlea na kumtengeneza mwandishi. Ndiyo maana Worton na Still (1990) wanasisitiza kwamba kila maandiko ni nyongeza kwa maandiko mengine. Hakuna maandishi yoyote yaliyokamilika na yasiyohitaji kuongezewa kutoka kwa maandishi mengine ili yawe na maana na yaeleweke. Hii ina maana kwamba hakuna maandishi yanayofanya kazi kama mfumo uliofungwa na kujitosheleza yenyewe; badala yake, kila maandishi yanategemea maandishi yaliyotangulia. Aidha, athari hii ya mwingiliano wa maandishi kutokana na kujifunza, kuishi kulingana na mafundisho ya dini, na kusoma vitabu vitakatifu haimhusu Anitha pekee, bali pia inaonekana katika kazi za wabunifu mashuhuri kama vile Abdilatif Abdallah, Euphrase Kezilahabi, Mwanakupona Binti Mshamu, Sayyid Abdalla Bin Ali bin Nasir, Shaaban Robert, Sheikh Umar bin al-Ahdaly, na wengineo wachache. Mtu ambaye hasomi maandiko matakatifu hawezi kutambua mwingiliano wa tamthilia hii na maandiko hayo, kama vile Biblia Takatifu, kwa sababu hana mifano ya awali inayoweza kuamsha hisia zake za utambuzi na kukumbuka kupitia muunganiko wa maana kati ya maandiko mbalimbali. Allegory ni mbinu ya kisanii inayotumiwa na mwandishi kuchagua jina linaloakisi tabia, mienendo na uzoefu wa mhusika katika kazi anayoiunda. Kwa mfano, mwandishi anaweza kumpa mhusika wake jina “Hasidi”. Ili kuthibitisha jina hili, mwandishi lazima amuunde mhusika huyo afanye matendo ya wivu kuanzia mwanzo hadi mwisho. Uchaguzi na uundaji wa wahusika ambao sifa zao zinaendana na majina yao ndiyo mbinu ya kisanii inayojulikana kama allegory. Kwa kawaida, wahusika hawa wana tabia za wahusika bapa (wale ambao hawabadiliki kitabia) ili kuitendea haki majina yao, kwa sababu iwapo wangekuwa wanabadilika kitabia, majina yao yasingeendana tena na sifa zao mpya. Hivyo basi, kimtazamo na kitabia, wahusika hawa hubaki vilevile kuanzia mwanzo hadi mwisho wa tamthilia. Mlacha na Madumulla (1991) wanawaelezea wahusika wa aina hii kuwa ni wale ambao hawaonekani kukua kitabia, kimatendo, wala kisaikolojia. Lengo kuu la mtazamo huu ni kuwashawishi watu wakubali matendo mema na majina yanayowakilisha wema, ili wakatae uovu na kupinga matumizi ya majina yenye maana mbaya, kwani jamii za Kiafrika zinaamini kwamba jina linaunda tabia ya mtu. Katika sekta ya kilimo, sumukuvu ni sumu au kemikali hatari inayozalishwa na aina fulani za fangasi zinazojulikana kama ukungu, ambazo huvamia na kushambulia mazao ya chakula na mafuta yanayotokana na mimea yenye majani na mbegu, hasa nafaka, kunde, mizizi, karanga, na malisho ya wanyama, aidha shambani au kwenye maghala ya kuhifadhi mazao. Sumukuvu haiwezi kuonekana kwa macho bila msaada wa vifaa maalumu, bali hutambulika kupitia vipimo maalum vya maabara. Viashiria vya uwepo wa sumukuvu kwenye zao ni pamoja na mbegu iliyoathiriwa kuonekana imeoza au kuwa na rangi tofauti na ile yake ya asili. Nukuu hii inathibitisha kuwepo kwa mwingiliano wa maandishi kati ya tamthilia ya Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu na taaluma ya kilimo. Lakini pia ni ushahidi kwamba kuna mazungumzo ya kimbinu kati ya tamthilia ya Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu na uteuzi na uundaji wa wahusika katika kazi za ubunifu za waandishi wengine, wakiwemo Shaaban Robert kupitia riwaya zake Kufikirika, Utubora Mkulima, na Kusadikika. Mbinu ya kuwapa wahusika majina yanayolingana na tabia zao na matendo yao ni maarufu sana katika kazi nyingi za ubunifu za Shaaban Robert (Ambrose, 2014; Saleh, 2015). Kwa mfano, katika riwaya ya Kusadikika kuna wahusika wawili wenye tabia zisizo na kina, yaani Karama na Majivuno. Mwangwi ni sauti inayorudiwa baada ya kutolewa, kama vile mtu anapopiga kelele ndani ya pango au msituni, ilhali falsafa inahusiana na uchunguzi wa asili, maana, na sababu za mambo, pamoja na hekima na busara (Kamusi ya Kiswahili Sanifu, 2013). Hivyo, mwangwi wa kifalsafa ni sauti inayorudiwa baada ya kutolewa kupitia uchunguzi wa asili, maana, na sababu za mambo, pamoja na hekima na busara. Tamthilia ya "Umoja Wetu, Ushindi Wetu" inaonyesha mwanamke anayevumilia mapambano makali na ya uchungu kwa ajili ya ukombozi. Tamthilia inaonyesha jinsi mwanamke huyo anavyojikuta karibu kukata tamaa, karibu kukubali kushindwa, lakini kwa msaada wa jamii kubwa inayomuunga mkono, hatimaye anashinda. Hii ni sauti ya kifalsafa inayotukumbusha msemo kuwa kidole kimoja hakiui chawa na kwamba umoja daima ni ushindi. Hii ndiyo falsafa ile ile inayoonekana katika tamthilia ya "Nguzo Mama" (2007) ya Penina Muhando. Tuanze kwa nukuu kutoka kwenye tamthilia "Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu," kisha tutaijadili kwa kuhusisha na ushahidi kutoka kwenye tamthilia "Nguzo Mama." Tunanukuu:
Tumetaja baadhi ya kauli zinazoonyesha sehemu ndogo ya tabia, mwenendo, na matendo ya Sumukuvu, pamoja na athari zake kwa familia ya mdogo wake, familia yake mwenyewe, na ukoo mzima kwa ujumla. Wakati Sumukuvu mwenyewe alijitenga na familia yake na ukoo wake kwa kukimbilia mahali kusikojulikana baada ya kushindwa kuelewana nao na aliposikia kuwa anatafutwa na polisi kwa mashtaka ya kula njama ya wizi na jaribio la mauaji. Kichwa cha habari hutumika kama kitambulisho cha sura au sehemu ndani ya tamthilia iliyoandikwa. Tamthilia ya *Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu* inaonekana kupanga mkondo wake wa matukio kwa kutumia aina mbili za vichwa vya habari – vichwa vikuu na vichwa vidogo. Vichwa vikuu (na vichwa vidogo vilivyowekwa kwenye mabano) vilivyotumika ni: Sehemu ya Kwanza (Neno), Sehemu ya Pili (Kipashio), Sehemu ya Tatu (Vifungu), Sehemu ya Nne (Sentensi), Sehemu ya Tano (Insha fupi), Sehemu ya Sita (Aya), na Sehemu ya Saba (Insha). Tunapotazama maneno yaliyotumika kama vichwa vidogo ili kutambua mpangilio wa hadithi, tunagundua kwamba maneno haya yanatokana na taaluma ya Isimu – Morfolojia na Sarufi kama ilivyoelezwa na kujadiliwa katika Massamba, Kihore, na Hokororo (2012), pamoja na katika uwanja wa stadi za mawasiliano. Maneno haya si maneno ya kawaida tu bali ni dhana za kitaaluma zinazorejelea vipengele vya msingi katika taaluma hizi mbili. Kiisimu, tunatambua kwamba haya ni istilahi zinazobeba maana mahususi za kitaalamu za neno husika, ingawa hadi sasa hakujawahi kuwa na makubaliano kuhusu maana ya dhana hizi—"neno," "kirai," "kiunganishi," "sentensi," "insha fupi," "aya," na "insha" (Kipacha, 2005). Ingawa hakuna makubaliano ya pamoja, lazima tukubali kwamba kuna maelezo ya kitaaluma yaliyotolewa na wanazuoni wa isimu. Hivyo basi, kupitia maelezo haya, tutaweza kuona kama uteuzi wa istilahi hizi za kiisimu una mantiki ya mwingiliano wa maandishi kati ya kazi ya fasihi bunilizi na taaluma ya isimu. Katika muktadha huu, dhamira zilizopatikana katika tamthilia *Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu* zimewezesha sana ufafanuzi wa tamthilia *Nguzo Mama*, ambayo imetolewa kwa njia ya kimajazi. Hii ni kusema kwamba kuna mazungumzo ya kifalsafa na kifikra kati ya Anitha E. Mgimba na Penina Muhando kupitia mjadala wa kutafuta njia bora ya kumkomboa mwanamke. Mazungumzo hayo si mengine bali ni falsafa kwamba kidole kimoja hakiwezi kamwe kuua chawa. Hii ina maana kwamba ukombozi wa kweli wa mwanamke hauwezi kupatikana kupitia juhudi zake binafsi pekee, bila kushirikiana na wanaume kuondoa pingu zinazowakandamiza wanawake katika nyanja zote za maisha ya binadamu. Ndiyo maana Anitha anahitimisha tamthilia yake kwa kusema, "[...]. Nakwambia mjomba, sirejei tena! [...] Ninashukuru kwamba umoja wetu umenipa ushindi juu ya njama za wasambazaji wa sumu. Hakika, kidole kimoja hakiwezi kuuua chawa. Hivyo basi, wakati maneno yanapokusanywa katika vikundi mbalimbali ambavyo bado havijafikia hadhi ya kuwa kishazi au sentensi, yanaitwa vishazi (Kipacha, 2005). Kwa hiyo, neno na neno lingine huunda kishazi. Vivyo hivyo, vishazi vinapounganishwa pamoja, vinaunda kishazi. Massamba (2004) anafafanua kishazi kama "muundo wenye kiima na kiarifu ambao upo ndani ya muundo mkuu." Vishazi kadhaa vikijumuishwa huunda sentensi; na sentensi kadhaa zikikusanywa pamoja, huunda muundo ambao kisha huunda aya, na aya nazo huzaa insha. Sentensi ni muundo uliokamilika wenyewe ambao kimsingi unahusisha tendo na mtendaji (TUKI, 2013). Kamusi hii ya Kiswahili Sanifu (TUKI, 2013) inaeleza neno "tungo" kama kipengele cha kimuundo kinachotokana na mpangilio wa mawasiliano, mofolojia, na sintaksia, pamoja na mtazamo unaoendana na taaluma fulani. Kama tulivyoona katika tamthilia Ngoswe Penzi Kitovu cha Uzembe na Nje – Ndani, hili linathibitisha bila shaka mchangamano wa maandishi (intertekstualiti) katika uteuzi na utambuzi wa vichwa vya tamthilia Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu na taaluma ya isimu – mofolojia, na pia kati ya tamthilia Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu na tamthilia nyingine, kama vile Ngoswe Penzi Kitovu cha Uzembe na Nje – Ndani. Mytholojia ya Alama
pamoja na muunganiko wa vitengo rahisi ili kuunda kitengo kikubwa zaidi, na insha hufafanuliwa kama utungo wa maneno kwa namna ya nathari kuhusu mada fulani. Kutokana na maelezo haya, tunagundua kwamba neno (au maneno) hutengeneza vikundi vya maneno, na vikundi hivi vya maneno hutengeneza vifungu, na vifungu hivi hutengeneza sentensi, kisha sentensi hutengeneza utungo, utungo hutengeneza aya, na aya kadhaa huunda insha. Kwa hiyo, tunachokiona hapa ni kwamba mwandishi ameandaa matukio yake kuanzia tukio dogo hadi tukio kubwa zaidi; yaani, alianza na jambo dogo lililozaa jambo kubwa, ambalo nalo lilipelekea jambo kubwa zaidi, kisha kubwa zaidi, na hatimaye kubwa kabisa, lililotokana na mkusanyiko wa mambo mengi. Hii ni makutano kati ya fasihi na taaluma ya isimu. Mitholojia ya alama ni mtazamo wa kisanii unaotumia taswira zinazoakisi simulizi za msingi za ubinadamu kuhusu imani zinazohusiana na nguvu za asili na/au uchawi. Mwandishi ametumia alama kadhaa zilizounganishwa na mitholojia, hasa mitholojia za Kiafrika. Moja ya alama ambazo hubeba mitholojia inayojulikana miongoni mwa jamii nyingi za Kiafrika na duniani kote ni nyoka mkubwa mweusi (Joka). Kulingana na Morris (katika Shanafelt, 2014), nyoka kama alama (hasa chatu) anahusishwa na mvua, maji, mnyororo wa kiikolojia, uzazi, na nguvu za kichawi/kiroho, pamoja na kuwa ishara ya kifo na ufufuo. Falsafa iliyotajwa na msomi huyu kuhusu nyoka na maana zake pia inaonekana katika maandiko matakatifu, hasa kwenye Biblia Takatifu (Mwanzo 3:14-15, Mwanzo 44:5, Kutoka 7:8-12, Hesabu 21:6-9, 1 Yohana 3:8, Ufunuo 12:9, Ufunuo 12:17, Ufunuo 20:2,10). Hii ndiyo sababu nyoka, kama ishara, ana nguvu kubwa, inayoanzia katika tamaduni za imani za jamii mbalimbali, si tu barani Afrika bali pia duniani kote (Hambly, 1929; Lynch na Roberts, 2010; Thomas, 2011; Shanafelt, 2014). Siyo lugha pekee inayonekana kusikika katika tamthilia hii, bali pia kuna aina nyingine ya mvumo. Kusikika huku ni kufananana kwa mtindo kati ya *Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu* na tamthilia nyingine kadhaa za Kiswahili, kwa mfano, *Ngoswe Penzi Kitovu cha Uzembe* (1988) iliyoandikwa na Edwin Semzaba na *Nje – Ndani* (2016) ya A. A. Majid Mswahili na M. S. Njonjolo. Edwin Semzaba ametumia ujuzi kutoka katika taaluma ya Jiomofolojia kuchagua na kuanzisha mkasa ili kuonesha chanzo cha tatizo hadi athari zake. Utambuzi huu umetumia dhana zifuatazo kwa mpangilio: Mkondo mdogo – Matawimto – Mto – Mto kuu – Hadi Baharini. Vivyo hivyo, A. A. Majid Mswahili na M. S. Njonjolo wametumia mbinu kutoka katika fani za afya na tiba ili kuchagua na kubainisha vipande vyao vya simulizi kwa madhumuni ya kuonyesha chanzo cha tatizo hadi athari zake. Walitumia mfuatano ufuatao wa dalili: Kisababishi cha Awali – Dalili ya Kwanza (Papule) – Dalili ya Pili (Mapapule) – Dalili ya Tatu (Noduli) – Dalili ya Nne (Uvimbe wenye usaha) – Dalili ya Tano (Maule ya usaha) – Dalili ya Sita (Kidonda). Ufafanuzi huu unatufanya kutambua kwamba matumizi ya joka, hasa nyoka wanaotisha, katika kazi za ubunifu si jambo jipya bali ni mwendelezo wa desturi za kisanii za kuchota kutoka katika tamaduni za kijamii—desturi—na kuziingiza katika kazi mpya za ubunifu. Katika tamthilia ya Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu, mwandishi anaonyesha uhusiano kati ya alama ya nyoka na maana yake kuhusiana na hadithi za kale. Yaani, nyoka mkubwa anatumika katika hadithi za kale kuwasilisha taarifa kuhusu tukio fulani linaloikabili jamii husika. Tunanukuu:
Hivyo basi, tamthilia ya Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu inaonesha ushawishi wa ujuzi wa mawasiliano na taaluma za lugha—Mofolojia na Sarufi—katika uteuzi na utambulisho wa majina ya mikondo ya matukio yake. Zaidi ya hayo, tamthilia hii pia inaingia kwenye mazungumzo ya kimitindo (kupitia uteuzi na utambulisho wa majina ya mikondo ya matukio) na tamthilia zilizotangulia kama vile Ngoswe Penzi Kitovu cha Uzembe na Nje – Ndani. Kupitia nukuu hizi, tunaona kwamba tamthilia *Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu* ina vipengele vya alama za kimatini vinavyoakisi mitholojia za kudumu za Waafrika pamoja na jamii nyingine nje ya bara la Afrika. Zaidi ya hayo, matumizi ya nyoka kama ishara ya kisanii hayajabaki katika tamthilia hii pekee bali pia yanaonekana katika kazi nyingine za ubunifu za Kiswahili. Fasihi simulizi, kama sanaa ya kale, mara nyingi hutumia nyoka wakubwa na viumbe wengine kuwakilisha Mungu, miungu, pepo, binadamu, au dhana fulani kupitia taswira. Hivyo basi, taswira ya viumbe kama vile nyoka wakubwa ni sehemu ya utajiri unaobebwa katika masimulizi ya jadi, jambo ambalo pia tunaliona katika fasihi simulizi na andishi ya jadi (Bertoncini, 1989; Madumulla, 2009). discourses.source_txt: Intertextuality is a method, skill, or discipline and a guide for the scientific analysis of texts, especially artistic and non-artistic works, to determine the presence of influence through borrowing or dialogue; that is, the similarity in form, content, and technique between one text and another. This resemblance can be direct or involve proximity. Such interaction is also referred to as an echo.

discourses.source_txt: It is believed that intertextuality is among the oldest compositional techniques; however, as a critical approach, it still appears to be unfamiliar and has not been extensively addressed in the field of Kiswahili literature and art. THEORETICAL FRAMEWORK  
These principles are: (i) it is not easy and indeed impossible to view a text as a product that is an orphan, in its own uniqueness and in isolation; instead, we must recognize that there are preceding texts that are related to the new text; (ii) texts interact and influence each other, so to think that a literary text is self-sufficient and independent is willful blindness; and (iii) an artistic text invites certain modes of expression and specific codes which help to signal an idea, event, work, or another subsequent work—thereby creating an impact on the creative work that follows (Kristeva, 1980). Based on these principles, we can say that intertextuality is a theory and academic skill that examines, identifies, and explains the relationships that exist between one text and another, in order to determine the direct or indirect (echoed) effects resulting from the interactions and mutual reinforcement of these texts. In other words, the theory of intertextuality is a guide for analyzing works of art, with a focus on literary texts, to determine the existence of borrowing or dialogue; that is, resemblance in genre, theme, and technique between one text and another. discourses.source_txt: The play employs language that is quickly and easily understood by anyone well-versed in Kiswahili. The dialogues constructed in this play evoke a variety of themes such as liberation, the role of women in society, social classes, sabotage, selfishness, intrigue, oppression, hatred, jealousy, greed, betrayal, exploitation, abuse, discrimination, transparency and truth, customs and traditions, unity and solidarity, family upbringing, effort and sustainable development, the importance of preserving records and identifying property, as well as the management and advancement of property, among others.
discourses.translated_txt: Tamthilia hii inatumia lugha ambayo inaeleweka kwa haraka na urahisi na mtu yeyote aliyebobea katika Kiswahili. discourses.source_txt: What is important for the reader of this article to understand is that intertextuality cannot be identified in a text if the analyst lacks background knowledge or familiarity with the knowledge, techniques, skills, and traits found in various preceding texts. Therefore, a person who can identify intertextuality in artistic works must be a highly knowledgeable and inquisitive individual, someone with a thirst and hunger for knowledge, techniques, skills, and the characteristic curiosity gained through exploring various creative works and a range of academic writings. On the contrary, a reader will not be able to discern the intertextuality within the creative work they are reading if they do not mentally perceive the resonances of knowledge, techniques, skills, and traits found in earlier works.
discourses.translated_txt: Jambo muhimu kwa msomaji wa makala hii kuelewa ni kwamba mwingiliano hauwezi kubainishwa katika maandishi endapo mchambuzi hana maarifa ya awali au ufahamu wa maarifa, mbinu, ujuzi, na sifa zilizopo katika maandishi mbalimbali yaliyotangulia. Hivyo basi, mtu anayeweza kubaini mwingiliano katika kazi za kisanii ni yule aliye na maarifa ya kina na mwenye hamu na shauku ya kujifunza; mtu mwenye kiu na njaa ya maarifa, mbinu, ujuzi, na udadisi unaopatikana kupitia kuchunguza kazi mbalimbali za ubunifu na maandishi ya kitaaluma tofauti tofauti. Kinyume chake, msomaji hataweza kutambua mwingiliano uliomo katika kazi ya ubunifu anayoisoma endapo hataweza kung’amua kiakili mwangwi wa maarifa, mbinu, ujuzi, na sifa zilizopo katika kazi zilizotangulia.

discourses.source_txt: The play is rich in various artistic and theoretical experiments and techniques. For example, within the play, there is intertextuality as each chapter is given a subtopic that refers to linguistic terms from the field of structural linguistics, in order to illustrate the birth and development of the subject matter being discussed by the author.
discourses.translated_txt: Tamthilia hii imejaa majaribio na mbinu mbalimbali za kisanaa na kinadharia. Kwa mfano, ndani ya tamthilia kunapatikana mwingiliano ambapo kila sura inapewa kichwa kidogo kinachorejelea istilahi za kiisimu kutoka katika taaluma ya isimu muundo, ili kuonesha kuzaliwa na kukua kwa mada inayojadiliwa na mwandishi.

discourses.source_txt: Another form of intertextuality is found in the use of illustrations and pictures, narrative techniques, and the unconventional expansion of stage directions, as well as the incorporation of dance, songs, music, poetry, boasting, choral verse, and the portrayal of the Dragon (Mgimba, 2017).
discourses.translated_txt: Aina nyingine ya mwingiliano inapatikana katika matumizi ya michoro na picha, mbinu za uandishi wa hadithi, na upanuzi usio wa kawaida wa maelekezo ya jukwaani, pamoja na ujumuishaji wa ngoma, nyimbo, muziki, mashairi, majigambo, utenzi wa kwaya, na uwasilishaji wa Joka (Mgimba, 2017).

discourses.source_txt: In addition, even the choice of the name “Sumukuvu,” which reflects traits and actions that signify the qualities of a particular thing or being, demonstrates another aspect of the work: the presence of features typical of characters in oral literature. For example, the character Sumukuvu can be seen either as a human character with a name resembling that of a poison or as a character from oral literature who has been personified and given life, then acts as a human being.
discourses.translated_txt: Aidha, hata uchaguzi wa jina “Sumukuvu,” ambalo linaakisi tabia na matendo yanayoashiria sifa za kitu au kiumbe fulani, unaonyesha upande mwingine wa kazi hii: kuwepo kwa sifa za kawaida za wahusika katika fasihi simulizi. Kwa mfano, mhusika Sumukuvu anaweza kuonekana aidha kama mhusika wa kibinadamu mwenye jina linalofanana na sumu, au kama mhusika wa fasihi simulizi ambaye ametwaliwa na kupewa uhai, kisha akatekeleza majukumu kama binadamu.

discourses.source_txt: This reason is consistent with what is thoroughly explained by Taylor and Taylor (1983) in their well-known book The Psychology of Reading. In this book, these scholars explain that, typically, the human brain has an area responsible for recording, storing, and rapidly retrieving memories of events and experiences a person has encountered. Therefore, when a reader comes across an event or technique that they have previously encountered in another work, their mind immediately responds and triggers a sensation that draws on the recall of that event or technique. The retrieval of a previous event, matter, or technique in relation to what has just been encountered produces an intersection of two texts. This intersection creates a resonance of the event, technique, or matter within the reader’s mind. All of these processes occur very rapidly.
discourses.translated_txt: Sababu hii inalingana na kile kilichoelezwa kwa undani na Taylor na Taylor (1983) katika kitabu chao mashuhuri *The Psychology of Reading*. Katika kitabu hiki, wataalamu hawa wanaeleza kwamba, kawaida, ubongo wa binadamu una sehemu maalumu inayohusika na kurekodi, kuhifadhi na kurejesha kwa haraka kumbukumbu za matukio na uzoefu ambayo mtu amewahi kukutana nayo. Hivyo, msomaji anapokutana na tukio au mbinu ambayo ameishawahi kukutana nayo katika kazi nyingine, akili yake hujibu mara moja na kuchochea hisia inayotia mkazo katika kukumbuka tukio au mbinu hiyo. Urejeshaji wa tukio, jambo, au mbinu ya awali kwa kuhusianisha na kile ambacho msomaji amekutana nacho hivi punde huzalisha mkutano kati ya maandishi mawili. Mkutano huu huunda mwangwi wa tukio, mbinu, au jambo hilo ndani ya akili ya msomaji. Mchakato huu wote hutokea kwa haraka sana.

discourses.source_txt:
SUMMARY OF THE PLAY OUR COHESION OUR TRIUMPH  
Our Cohesion Our Triumph is a Swahili play with a strong feminist orientation, synthesizing the effects of the behaviors and actions of certain members of society who perpetuate misguided beliefs, envy, hatred, selfishness, and various forms of abuse toward others.  
In the agricultural sector, Sumukuvu (mycotoxin) refers to a poison or toxic chemicals produced by a type of fungus known as Kuvu, which grows and frequently attacks food crops and oil-yielding plants, especially those with leaves and seeds, notably cereals, legumes, roots, groundnuts, and animal feeds either on the farm or in storage.
discourses.translated_txt:
MUHTASARI WA TAMTHILIA MSHIKAMANO WETU USHINDI WETU  
Mshikamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu ni tamthilia ya Kiswahili yenye msimamo mkali wa kimwanamke, inayochambua athari za tabia na vitendo vya baadhi ya wanajamii wanaoendeleza imani potofu, wivu, chuki, ubinafsi, na aina mbalimbali za ukatili dhidi ya wengine.  
Katika sekta ya kilimo, Sumukuvu (sumu kuvu) hurejelea sumu au kemikali hatari zinazozalishwa na aina ya ukungu uitwao Kuvu, ambayo hukua na mara nyingi hushambulia mimea ya chakula na mazao ya mafuta, hasa yale yenye majani na mbegu, kama vile nafaka, kunde, mizizi, karanga na malisho ya wanyama mashambani au wakati wa kuhifadhi.

discourses.source_txt: Sumukuvu is not visible to the naked eye but can be detected using special laboratory tests. Moreover, this play identifies several images, including the dragon, the green lamp, thick fog, darkness, and an accident.

discourses.source_txt: In addition, unlike many nuns, Anitha underwent National Service training (J.K.T) in Tanzania, as required by law, at Camp 832KJ - J.K.T Ruvu, in Pwani Region, in 2013. The reason she attended the military training was because the Superior General (who had been elected for another term—the third time), Sr. Teresina Gervasia Kindole, encouraged and emphasized to everyone selected to join that program to go for the training without considering their religious vocation. This decision and firm stance by the Superior General stem from the fact that she herself had undergone J.K.T training as required by law, and therefore she saw no problem with her nuns attending these trainings, given the benefits she herself had gained from the military.

discourses.source_txt: This is indisputable evidence that this play was not created out of thin air, but rather the writer drew knowledge, skills, and experience from the sacred writings of the religion that raised and nurtured him, as we noted in the writer’s biography. All the quotations we referenced clearly reflect the echoes of earlier texts, thus strongly confirming that composition and writing cannot be divorced from the influence of preceding texts or the physical and spiritual environments that raised and shaped the writer.
discourses.translated_txt: Huu ni ushahidi usiopingika kwamba tamthilia hii haikuandikwa bila misingi, bali mwandishi alichota maarifa, ujuzi na uzoefu kutoka katika maandiko matakatifu ya dini iliyomlea na kumkuza, kama tulivyobainisha katika wasifu wake. Nukuu zote tulizorejelea zinaakisi wazi athari za maandiko yaliyotangulia, na hivyo kudhihirisha kwa nguvu kwamba uandishi na utunzi haviwezi kutenganishwa na ushawishi wa maandiko yaliyotangulia au mazingira ya kimwili na kiroho yaliyomlea na kumtengeneza mwandishi.

discourses.source_txt: That is why Worton and Still (1990) emphasize that every text is a supplement to another text.

discourses.source_txt: There is no text that is complete and does not require supplementation from other texts in order to be meaningful and comprehensible. This means that no text functions as a closed, self-contained system; rather, every text is dependent on preceding texts.

discourses.source_txt: Allegory is an artistic device used by a writer to choose a name that reflects the character, behavior, and experiences of a character in the work they are creating. For example, a writer may name their character “Hasidi” (The Envious One). To justify this name, the writer must develop that character to act with envy from beginning to end. The selection and creation of characters whose traits align with their names is the artistic technique known as allegory.
discourses.translated_txt: Allegory ni mbinu ya kisanii inayotumiwa na mwandishi kuchagua jina linaloakisi tabia, mienendo na uzoefu wa mhusika katika kazi anayoiunda. Kwa mfano, mwandishi anaweza kumpa mhusika wake jina “Hasidi”. Ili kuthibitisha jina hili, mwandishi lazima amuunde mhusika huyo afanye matendo ya wivu kuanzia mwanzo hadi mwisho. Uchaguzi na uundaji wa wahusika ambao sifa zao zinaendana na majina yao ndiyo mbinu ya kisanii inayojulikana kama allegory.

discourses.source_txt: Normally, these characters possess the traits of flat characters (those who do not undergo changes in character) in order to justify their names, because if they were to change in character, their names would no longer correspond to their new traits. Therefore, in terms of character and stance, these characters remain unchanged from the beginning to the end of the play. Mlacha and Madumulla (1991) describe such characters as ones who do not appear to grow in character, actions, or psychologically.
discourses.translated_txt: Kwa kawaida, wahusika hawa wana tabia za wahusika bapa (wale ambao hawabadiliki kitabia) ili kuitendea haki majina yao, kwa sababu iwapo wangekuwa wanabadilika kitabia, majina yao yasingeendana tena na sifa zao mpya. Hivyo basi, kimtazamo na kitabia, wahusika hawa hubaki vilevile kuanzia mwanzo hadi mwisho wa tamthilia. Mlacha na Madumulla (1991) wanawaelezea wahusika wa aina hii kuwa ni wale ambao hawaonekani kukua kitabia, kimatendo, wala kisaikolojia.

discourses.source_txt: The main goal of this approach is to persuade the public to embrace good deeds and names that embody goodness, so as to reject evil and oppose the use of names that carry negative meanings, since African societies believe that a name shapes the character of the individual.

discourses.source_txt: In the agricultural sector, a mycotoxin is a poison or toxic chemical produced by certain types of fungi known as molds, which primarily infest and attack food and oil crops derived from leafy plants and seeds, especially cereals, legumes, roots, groundnuts, and animal fodder, either in the field or in storage facilities.

discourses.source_txt: Mycotoxin cannot be seen with the naked eye but is detected through special laboratory tests. Indicators of the presence of mycotoxin in a crop include the affected crop (seed) appearing rotten or having a color different from its original one.

discourses.source_txt: This quotation confirms the existence of intertextuality between the play Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu and the academic field of agriculture. Philosophical and Conceptual Echo

An echo is a sound that is repeated after being produced, such as when a person shouts inside a cave or forest, while philosophy refers to the study of the nature, meaning, and reasons for things, as well as wisdom and prudence (Kamusi ya Kiswahili Sanifu, 2013). Therefore, a philosophical echo is a sound that is repeated after being produced through the study of the nature, meaning, and reasons for things, as well as wisdom and prudence.

Mwangwi ni sauti inayorudiwa baada ya kutolewa, kama vile mtu anapopiga kelele ndani ya pango au msituni, ilhali falsafa inahusiana na uchunguzi wa asili, maana, na sababu za mambo, pamoja na hekima na busara (Kamusi ya Kiswahili Sanifu, 2013). discourses.source_txt: Some of the imaginative works featuring the use of the large snake both symbolically and in meaning, which we can associate with the play *Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu*, include: *Adili and His Brothers* (Robert, 1952), *A Famous Person in the History of Usukuma* (Boaz, 1974), *Traditional Shield* (Hussein, 1976), *Hero Gishegu* (Masatu, no year), *The Man-Eating Nondo*, *The Man-Eating Nunda and Other Stories* (Hellier, 1964), *The Dance of Ng’wanamalundi* (Mbogo, 1988), and *The Snake’s Skin* (Kezilahabi, 2006). In all these works, the use of the large snake carries an element of magical wonder, signifying, among other things, wealth, death, protection and security, healing and health, witchcraft, fertility, oppression, suffering, and authority.
